reason: A frosted-glass and Monet theme plugin for the dsh Web UI that adds customizable backgrounds, slideshow support, theme transitions and scheduling, composer lighting effects, and opt-in system notifications.

summaries.zh: 为 dsh Web UI 提供磨砂玻璃与 Monet 主题、自定义图片或视频背景、主题切换效果及可选系统通知。
summaries.en: Adds frosted-glass and Monet themes to the dsh Web UI with custom image or video backgrounds, theme transitions, scheduling, and optional system notifications.

capabilities: Modifies global web UI styling and theme tokens
Adds theme transition and scheduled light/dark switching
Stores custom images, videos, and preferences locally
Uses browser Notification API for opt-in run and question notifications
Can sample screen or wallpaper sources for color extraction
Uses a host-side wallpaper API and subprocess fallback for desktop wallpaper detection
